query:
query FilesForSearchContests($filters: SearchFilters!) {
		files(filters: $filters) {
			id
			url
			publishStatus
			title
			fileName
			importStatus
			model
			mimeType
			nContests
			nContestsVerified
			nBallotQuestions
			nBallotQuestionsPublished
			nVoterStats
			nVoterStatsVerified
			nVoterStatsPublished
			yearStart
			yearEnd
			maxStartDate
			isWebDocument
			isImportable
			isSource
			isConverted
			nProofreadInSequence
			isLabelsInFirstRow
			isSumDuplicateRows
			csvDelimiter
			csvEnclosure
			fixedWidthFieldPositions
			filePath
			externalUrl
			fileSize
			pageAdjustment
			isTitlePage
			titlePageNumber
			nRows
			nRowsProcessed
			errorDescription
			errorData
		}
	}
